gitAlias.title: Install {command} command
gitAlias.explanation: This adds a Git alias to your global Git configuration, so that running {command} in any repository opens its unstaged changes in Diff Trek, and {rangeExample} opens a commit or range.
gitAlias.alreadySetUp: {command} is already set up for this copy of Diff Trek.
gitAlias.usage: In any Git repository, run {command} to see its unstaged changes in Diff Trek. Add a commit or range to see that instead, as in {commitExample} or {rangeExample}.
gitAlias.screen.openFromGit.title: Open Diff Trek from Git

gitAlias.screen.openFromGit.lastCommit: To see the last committed changes, type {command} and press Return.
gitAlias.screen.install.title: Install the {command} command
gitAlias.screen.update.title: Update the {command} command
gitAlias.screen.install.message: Diff Trek shows the changes in a Git repository, and opens from Git itself. Install the {command} command, then run it in any repository to see its changes here.
gitAlias.screen.update.message: Diff Trek shows the changes in a Git repository, and opens from Git itself. Your {command} command does not open this copy of Diff Trek. Update it, then run {command} in any repository.
gitAlias.screen.alongside.install.title: Set up {command}

gitAlias.screen.alongside.install.messag: to open the changes in any Git repository here.
